rules: Feature snapshots may be collected without inspecting future outcomes.
No forward outcome may enter the feature ledger.
Existing ledger rows may never be rewritten.
The frozen V3-015 Treasury research snapshot may never be refreshed by the forward collector.
Post-cutoff Treasury observations are stored in a separate append-only source ledger with capture dates.
A forward feature row may use only Treasury observations captured on or before its decision date.
A checkpoint date range becomes research-exposed permanently when intentionally opened.
Post-DIAG experiments must be pre-registered before consuming an opened checkpoint's outcomes.
